review_description: We had our system installed around 12 months ago with these guys. While they were ok to deal with in the lead-up, when it came time to install there were several changes made at the last minute. They weren’t able to install as many panels as they initially said, they failed to pass on to the installers that there should be optimisers on our panels, and the brand of inverter had to be changed due to their own stock issues. If we had known all of these changes would be made, we would have gone with another provider instead.Most frustratingly though, the sales guy also promised a consumption monitor would be included in our package. Apparently he didn’t have authorisation for this but the manager agreed to honour it. However, despite over a dozen attempts to follow up on this and contact the manager, they stopped answering my calls, emails and texts and ultimately didn’t provide it which was really disappointing.
